mode.title: Scraping Mode
mode.description: Choose the scraping mode: product_only (items only), seller_only (sellers only), or product_and_seller (both)

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description:
URLs to start scraping from. For product modes, use item URLs (e.g., https://www.ebay.com/itm/...). For seller_only, use seller store/profile URLs (e.g., https://www.ebay.com/str/... or https://www.ebay.com/usr/...).

Any eBay marketplace works — ebay.com, ebay.es, ebay.de, ebay.co.uk, ebay.com.au and so on. The scraper stays on the domain you give it: the page is scraped in that site's language, prices come back in that marketplace's currency, and the proxy exits in that country.
